theory.intro: To multiply by a 2-digit number, partition **both** numbers by place value (the area model gives four part-products) or use the standard algorithm.
facts: The area model for $2 \times 2$ digits gives **four** part-products.
The algorithm multiplies by the ones, then the tens (shifted one place), then adds.
steps: Split each number into tens and ones.
Multiply every part of one by every part of the other.
Add all the part-products for the total.

foundation.question_text: Use the multiplication algorithm to calculate $24 \times 13$.
Use the multiplication algorithm to calculate $46 \times 27$.
Use the multiplication algorithm to calculate $72 \times 18$.

development.question_text: Use the multiplication algorithm to calculate $125 \times 24$.
Use the multiplication algorithm to calculate $306 \times 17$.
Use the multiplication algorithm to calculate $248 \times 36$.
In the algorithm for $413 \times 22$, explain why the second partial product is $8260$, not $826$. Then find the product.
development.solution_text:
The second digit represents $2$ tens, so $413 \times 20=8260$.
$413 \times 2=826$.
$826+8260$
$=9086$

mastery.question_text: An area model for $76 \times 63$ has part-products $4200$, $210$, $360$ and $18$. Explain which multiplication produces each part, then find the total.
